Markets.title: Stock rally keeps rupee upbeat, traders eye exporters for fresh fuel
Markets.sum: The Indian rupee has surged to its highest value in seven months, driven by a notable uptick in equity markets. Business.title: Saudi Arabia overtakes UAE as India's No. 2 oil supplier; Russia retains lead
Business.sum: India's oil imports from Saudi Arabia rose significantly in October, exceeding those from the UAE. Saudi imports reached approximately 790,000 barrels per day, while UAE imports fell to 612,000 barrels per day. This shift occurred after the Iran war disrupted regional supplies and caused competition among Gulf producers. Indian refiners increased Russian oil purchases sharply as well amid changing market dynamics.
